description: This Java source file defines the SimpleEventHandler class, which handles simple events in the OFBiz web application framework. It manages event invocation, transaction handling, and error processing.

classes.name: SimpleEventHandler
classes.description: Handles simple web events, manages transactions, and processes errors within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the servlet context. Currently a no-op.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Processes an event by executing a simple event script, managing transactions, and handling errors. Returns the event result or 'error' on failure.
